entities.name: UQCRB
observations: Identified as an oxymatrine-recognizing protein through affinity biopanning of a T7 phage cDNA library; SPR and ITC supported binding, with reported affinities in the millimolar range.

entities.name: Oxymatrine
observations: Small-molecule ligand tested in a T7 phage-display screen that identified UQCRB as a candidate binding protein.

entities.name: PMID:27497639
observations: 2016 Journal of Ethnopharmacology paper: “Identification of UQCRB as an oxymatrine recognizing protein using a T7 phage display screen.”

entities.name: UQCRB recognizes oxymatrine
observations: Affinity biopanning of a T7 phage cDNA library identified UQCRB; phage binding controls, SPR, and ITC supported interaction, although reported binding constants were millimolar.
